name: combobox
description: A searchable, filterable dropdown control — single selection, multi-selection, search-as-you-type, free-form tag entry, or time selection.

combobox-trigger.purpose: Trigger input — Types: Basic, Search, Time-picker (Figma) + Tag Input (code-only). 19 Figma variants + 6 code-only Tag Input.

combobox-field.purpose: Complete form field with label, trigger, description or dropdown.

intent.Time-picker: Opens menu-dropdown Type=os-time-menu for structured HH/MM selection. Visually identical to Basic (placeholder + chevron). Use when user selects time rather than typing it.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

constraints: Use combobox-field, not combobox-trigger, for standard form use.
Use combobox over select for long lists, search, filtering, or multi-select.
Use State=Filled-chips only with multiple=true or type=tag-input.
Use select-field for short stable lists with no search needed.
Use type=tag-input for free-form values not from a predefined list.
Use type=basic or type=search only for predefined options lists.
Match Search trigger with Search dropdown.
Tag Input: Enter or comma confirms a chip. Backspace removes the last chip when input is empty. Duplicates are silently ignored.

useCases: Assigning team members to a task — large org, user types a name to filter hundreds of people
Tag or label picker in a note-taking or project tool — multi-select with chips, large tag vocabulary
Language or locale selector in account settings — 100+ languages, search is the only sensible UX
'CC' or recipient field in an email composer — add multiple addresses as chips
Framework or technology filter in a job board — long list of options, user types to narrow

Type=Basic.whenToUse: Moderate-length list where the user browses to pick — click to open, scan the list

Type=Basic, State=Filled-chips.whenToUse: Multi-select where each chosen value must be visually represented and individually removable

Type=Search.whenToUse: Long list (15+ items) where typing to filter is the primary interaction

comparedTo.situation: Long list or user types to filter (>15 items)
Short fixed list (≤ ~10 items), no typing, pick one
User enters a completely free-form value not from a list
2–5 mutually exclusive options that benefit from being fully visible

notes: Examples assume a ComboboxField wrapper API over the chosen Base UI implementation; source markdown itself does not mark this component not ready.
Type=Tag Input is code-only (not in Figma). Type=Time-picker is Figma-built; opens menu-dropdown Type=os-time-menu.

knownIssues.issue: Dropdown width hardcoded to 280px — CSS var --anchor-width from Base UI Positioner doesn't resolve reliably on Popup element.
knownIssues.workaround: w-[280px] hardcoded on Combobox.Popup. If container width changes, update both the story wrapper and popupClass.

changelog.change: Dropdown width fix: was hardcoded w-[280px]. Root cause of misalignment — Base UI anchors the Positioner to the Input (~50px narrower than the bordered Trigger box due to padding + chevron), so --anchor-width measured 230px not 280px. Fix: ref the Combobox.Trigger and pass anchor={triggerRef} to the Positioner; Positioner uses w-[var(--anchor-width)] min-w-[200px], Popup w-full. Now the dropdown matches the full trigger width. Single-select + multi-select. Tag-input uses absolute left-0/right-0 and was unaffected. Verified in-browser (trigger 280 = dropdown 280).
Added Type=Tag Input variant (free-form chip creation). Dropdown: radius/lg, p-0.5, gap-0.5, h-8 items, px-2. Invalid state: red ring via [&[data-popup-open]] compound selector.
Type=Time-picker added to combobox-trigger in Figma (node 401:2567, 6 state variants). Opens menu-dropdown Type=os-time-menu. Total: 19 Figma + 6 code-only = 25.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.

notes: Type=Basic/Search: @base-ui/react Combobox. Type=Tag Input: custom controlled state, no Base UI.
Dropdown width hardcoded w-[280px] — CSS var --anchor-width unreliable in Base UI Positioner.
Filtering: manual label.toLowerCase().includes() — not using useComboboxFilter hook.
